findings.description: Lucia Skora's parents were Antonius Skora and Elisabeth Skrownionka, named on her baptism at Przecław on 13 November 1807.
supporting_sources: Poland, Tarnow, Roman Catholic Diocese Church Books, 1612-1900 — baptism of Lucia Skora, Przecław, 13 Nov 1807, daughter of Antonius Skora and Elisabeth Skrownionka (so spelled on this hinted index; the duplicate indexes 6VQK-F3N3 and 6V3J-2YZ3 spell the mother Skowronionka — a spelling variant of one woman; the only Lucia Skora baptism at Przecław 1803-1813 found in the FamilySearch index) — ark:/61903/1:1:X54T-461
